# Value Fabric

> Value Fabric is a production-grade, multi-tenant enterprise agentic SaaS platform. It transforms unstructured enterprise data into structured, actionable knowledge through a six-layer, ontology-guided semantic pipeline. Autonomous AI agents reason over a knowledge graph to produce ROI analyses, business cases, and executive insights at scale with full auditability.

## Important notes

- This is a **contract-first, tenant-safe, layered, provider-agnostic** monorepo. Preserve API contracts, tenant isolation, and layer boundaries when making changes.
- The repository is **pnpm-only** (pinned `pnpm@10.34.5`). Never use `npm install` or `yarn install`.
- Backend services require **Python 3.11+**. The `Makefile` is the canonical build, test, migration, and release-gate interface.
- Frontend changes (`apps/web/`) are governed by `DESIGN.md` — required reading before editing.
- Tenant isolation, auth, RBAC, and governance middleware are first-class invariants and must never be weakened.

## Architecture (six-layer pipeline)

- Frontend: React / Vite / TanStack Query / Zustand / Tailwind / shadcn/ui
- Layer 1 — Intelligent Data Ingestion (port 8001): Playwright crawling, Celery/Redis queues, PostgreSQL state, compliance-aware ingestion
- Layer 2 — Ontology-Guided Extraction (port 8002): Pydantic v2 extraction, LLM extraction, RDF/OWL generation, provenance
- Layer 3 — Knowledge Graph & Semantic Layer (port 8003): Neo4j, GraphRAG, hybrid retrieval, pgvector, subgraph APIs
- Layer 4 — Agentic Workflow Engine (port 8004): LangGraph workflows, ROI calculator, business case generation, checkpoints
- Layer 5 — Ground Truth (port 8005): TruthObject validation, maturity ladder, evidence-backed claims
- Layer 6 — Benchmark Service (port 8006): peer comparison, statistical validation, datasets
